title: School's Out Sport Fishing LLC
specs: Fleet includes 34ft Pursuit Summer School, 35ft Luhrs Alura School's Out, Spring Break, and Hewescraft Alaskan 270
A (2) day Great Lakes fishing license required for all anglers
Charters accommodate 1-6 people; larger groups by coordinating additional boats
Fleet includes four boats in summer for larger group charters
includes: Fish cleaning and bagging included in charter rate
Fishing licenses included in packages or available onboard for $14
blurb: School's Out Sport Fishing offers guided fishing charters on Lake Michigan and Lake Erie, including salmon and walleye fishing. They provide various trip durations and packages with lodging options. The fleet includes multiple boats suitable for small to larger groups.
extraNote: $250 security deposit due at booking, nonrefundable · Full balance charged if cancelled within 7 days or no-shows · Deposits transferable only if captain determines lake conditions unsafe · Charters cut short due to sea-sickness still charged full amount · 15-20% gratuity customary and appreciated · Prices do not include 5.5% Wisconsin sales tax · Docked at 2 Christopher Columbus Causeway, Slips E3-35, 37, 39 & 42, Racine, Wisconsin 53403
